name: legal-cognitive-sparring
description: Spar with a qualified lawyer on arguments, understanding, opposing positions, assumptions, evidence, and strategy. Jurisdiction is lawyer-supplied. The plugin does not give final legal advice or invent citations.

interface.shortDescription: Spars with a qualified lawyer on reasoning, gaps, and strategy. Jurisdiction is lawyer-supplied. It does not give final advice or invent citations.
interface.longDescription: Twelve workflows that pressure a qualified lawyer's own thinking. Core sparring stress-tests an argument, probes understanding, argues the other side, steelmans and then attacks, and answers as a named decision-maker. Structure and gaps extracts assumptions, lists what has not been addressed, forces a burden and standard, and red-teams the evidence. Strategy challenges forum, timing, and settlement choices, checks a plain-language restatement for lost nuance, and runs a short oral drill. The lawyer supplies the jurisdiction, forum, governing law, facts, and authorities. The plugin states no legal rule of any legal system. A qualified lawyer owns every outcome.
defaultPrompt: Pressure-test this argument. Jurisdiction and sources are as I supply them. Do not rewrite it as final advice.
Steelman my position, then attack that steelman in a separate phase.
List the assumptions this analysis turns on, and how I could falsify each one.
Red-team the evidence. Do not rule on admissibility.
